### Consolidated Water Awarded $39.8 Million Design-Build Agreement for Central Coast Blue Advanced Water Purification Facility


10/12/2026


GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=W0ZMLezNbQOWBO0Gv749nsKPqaSsO0993mu_KRkhKYOpm7lGPdYUpckKUo8-bX1fs2oCoeJgP7_Wqp3zX_wstlkLxSdEu3f0vzWNmw8_kWE=) (NASDAQ Global Select Market: CWCO), a leading designer, builder and operator of advanced water treatment plants, today announced that its U.S. subsidiary, PERC Water Corporation, has been awarded a design-build agreement by the City of Pismo Beach, California, valued at approximately $39.8 million for the Central Coast Blue Advanced Water Purification Facility.


The award followed a public, two-step competitive procurement process. After evaluating proposals from three qualified design-build teams, including extensive interviews, the City determined that PERC Water submitted the best overall proposal. Under the agreement, PERC Water will design, construct and test the facility, train City personnel and support initial operations. The approved project scope provides for an advanced water purification facility with annual production capacity of approximately 750 acre-feet.


The project includes an advanced treatment train incorporating ultrafiltration, three-stage reverse osmosis and ultraviolet advanced oxidation, together with equalization and purified-water storage, chemical storage and feed systems, pumping, pipeline connections, electrical and control systems, and groundwater recharge infrastructure consisting of one injection well and two monitoring wells. Project implementation also includes regulatory coordination, startup and commissioning, performance and acceptance testing, and operational-readiness support.


Central Coast Blue is intended to establish a new local, drought-resistant water supply for the southern portion of San Luis Obispo County. The project is expected to help diversify the City’s water-supply portfolio, improve long-term water reliability, and protect the local groundwater basin from seawater intrusion.


“This award reflects the strength of our advanced water-treatment capabilities and our ability to compete successfully for technically sophisticated design-build projects,” said Consolidated Water CEO Rick McTaggart. “We are proud that PERC Water was selected following a rigorous competitive evaluation, and we look forward to supporting the City of Pismo Beach as it advances a reliable, locally controlled, and drought-resistant water supply.”


The design-build project is expected to proceed through design, permitting construction, startup and commissioning over approximately 24 months. The project is anticipated to enter the construction phase in spring 2027.


**About Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.**


Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. develops and operates advanced water treatment plants and water distribution systems. The company designs, constructs and operates seawater desalination facilities in the Cayman Islands, The Bahamas and the British Virgin Islands, and designs, constructs and operates water treatment and reuse facilities in the United States.


The company also manufactures and services a wide range of products and provides design, engineering, management, operating and other services applicable to commercial and municipal water production, supply and treatment, and industrial water and wastewater treatment.
